sentences.text:
The offences alleged are under Sections 270, 273,
328 and 420 r/w 34 IPC and Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners/A.3, A.6 & A.7 under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against them in FIR.No.157 of 2019 on the file of the Sattenapalli Town Police Station, Guntur District.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR.No.157 of 2019 on the file of the Sattenapalli Town Police Station, Guntur District, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
